topic: Tape measure: why does it snap back? (spiral return spring)
caption:
Why does a tape measure snap back? 🤔
Bonus: why is the metal hook loose? Guess 👇
Follow @whyloop.hq for a new machine every day
#tapemeasure #howitworks #engineering #mechanism #tools
firstComment:
Answer: a coiled spring 🌀

In most tape measures, a flat spiral spring sits inside the reel. Its inner end is hooked onto a fixed post in the middle, and its outer end is attached to the reel. Pull the tape out and the reel turns, winding the spring tighter around the post. Let go, and the spring unwinds, spinning the reel so it winds the tape back in.

The loose hook is on purpose: it is riveted through oval holes, so it can slide by its own thickness. That way inside and outside measurements both read true.

(Simplified 3D model: the tape layers are drawn thicker than real, and the lock button is not shown working.)

Sources:
US patent US20110099828A1 (return spring, a flat spiral coil on a fixed axle, wound as the drum turns): https://patents.google.com/patent/US20110099828A1
US patent US11815350B2 (in typical designs the spiral spring sits inside the tape reel and stores energy as the tape is extended): https://patents.google.com/patent/US11815350B2
Wikipedia, Tape measure (hook on loose rivets through oval holes, moves by its own thickness): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tape_measure
altText: 3D animation of a yellow tape measure on a wooden workbench. The pulled-out blade snaps back into the case until the metal hook hits the case. The side cover sweeps away to show the reel of yellow tape and, inside it, a flat spiral spring around a fixed center post. An orange arrow pulls the tape out: the reel turns and the spring's coils wind tighter around the post. When the arrow lets go, the spring unwinds, the reel spins and the tape is pulled back in. The cover closes again. Text on screen: Why does it snap back? The spring.

principle: A flat spiral spring between a fixed center post and the rotating reel is wound tighter as the blade is pulled out; on release it unwinds and turns the reel to rewind the blade.
